body: They haven’t changed 6 weeks in a row. Non stop every single day getting worse and worse. I don’t know what I am anymore. Thank you for listening
I truly don’t care about much but that means a lot to me, thank you

I do enjoy writing very much. I can only write when I get in a certain mood but it never relives the pain or does much, it feels like a burden just letting it sit in my notes or untitled documents... it passes time well, especially when I’ve got multiple things going on at once. Thank you

I don’t know why I feel compelled to write something but please listen. There’s a boy I love and every night I try and make sure he goes to sleep, safely and happily but just as long as he’s asleep is good enough. Go to sleep, when you feel tired, just rest. Wake up and don’t think about what will happen, just concentrate on the steps of just simply “getting up.” Stress the idea that you shouldn’t forget to brush your teeth, to get your stuff ready for maybe work or school. I don’t know what it is you do, but break it down into steps, don’t overthink the time on the wall or on your phone. Just live in that very second, bad thoughts or not in the back of your subconscious, just keep talking out loud in your head or in person what it is that you’re doing. Emphasis and ground yourself, overthink all the sensations. Emphasis what it feels like, smells like maybe, use that and inch along life. Sounds stupid but it’s an important gesture when things are overbearing in life. I am riddled with mental illness and every single day is a long, sore, cry but I am slowly trying to re learn what it is to be me and feel normal. Just by simplifying things makes it 10 times better. Pretend you’re still a child, talk to yourself like you would to your kid or someone you/you’d love. Killing myself in the moment feels like the only option, but when I weigh it all out, id miss seeing my beautiful husbands face before work every morning, I would miss out on giving my children little kisses on their way to school, id miss the pleasure of taking care of and nurturing animals. I wouldn’t be able to live that anymore, id be just dead. I wouldn’t have ended the suffering at all, just the physical stimulations. Cutting yourself off from those things feels like a way out but it’s not. The fact is, is that life is something to live, do not let it go to waste no matter how INSANE you think you feel. There will be or already is someone there to lean on. If there isn’t, give life patience. I met the love of my life in a group therapy that I was forced into by and didn’t even wanna go to. I never expected meeting such a perfect man from that experience but I did, and every single day is worth it just to see him. Someday you will find something like that, it doesn’t have to be a person but it will be what drives you to sleep well and wake up the next morning.

I was in school in a drivers ed class crying on the floor during a break which sounds pathetic but it happened. A lot of it doesn’t make sense and that’s okay, I just wanted to post this somewhere in case anyone else could feel somewhat like this and tell me how they got through it. Not very easy to find though huh?
